parts.text: A student tests two substances: solid K and solid L . Tests on solid K The student dissolves solid K in water to form solution K . The student divides solution K into four portions. Table 3.1 shows the tests and the student’s observations for solution K . Table 3.1 tests observations test 1 To the first portion of solution K , add a few drops of aqueous ammonia. white precipitate test 2 To the second portion of solution K , add a few drops of acidified aqueous potassium manganate( VII ). pale purple solution test 3 To the third portion of solution K , add 1 cm 3 of dilute nitric acid followed by a few drops of aqueous silver nitrate. cream precipitate test 4 To the fourth portion of solution K , add aqueous chlorine. the solution becomes orange
